risk_note: RV2 (orders update step, platform metrics, monitoring rules; no money moved). FU-TB-FEE-MISSING-METRIC (orchestrator D10-741 ⑤, D10-992 ① option (a), D10-1003). The 'order already has an estimate, a later report lacks the service fee' condition now lives in one place (service-fee-alert.ts serviceFeeMissingCounts: serviceFeeDeducted platforms only, so jd never counts; a fee of 0n is present). update-step counts the new labelled counter couli_service_fee_missing_total{platform} for pdd and taobao; for pdd the old couli_pdd_service_fee_missing_total and the pdd_service_fee_missing warn are unchanged (double write), taobao never touches them ([AC-B1-04zz#21] green). Per D10-1003 ① the counter is a standard labelled counter: a platform's series appears only once it has been counted (frozen [AC-B1-01zzh#5] unchanged). couli.yaml adds CouliServiceFeeMissing (sum by (platform) (increase(couli_service_fee_missing_total[1h])) > 0, 5m, warning) after CouliPddServiceFeeMissing, which stays; frozen [AC-B1-01zzo#10] only appends that entry (D10-1003 ②, B1-04zy precedent; test_paths #2801). No new log line. Host: rule + frozen metric specs 70/70, int service-fee-missing-metric 4/4, pdd-net-n 15/15, taobao-net-n 9/9, api unit 942; tsc only in CI. Known S2 from both money reviewers, reported to the orchestrator: with a lazy series the first taobao miss after a worker restart starts the series at 1, so increase()[1h] reads 0 and the new alert does not fire for that event (pdd is still covered by the legacy alert). Round 4 (CI on #2813): frozen alerting-eval [AC-B1-25b#8] needs a sample line for every metric an alert rule uses, which the lazy series could not give at startup, while frozen [AC-B1-01zzh#5] forbids any platform="pdd" series in that render. Orchestrator D10-1051 replaced D10-1003 ①: couli_service_fee_missing_total exports {platform="taobao"} 0 from startup, pdd only after its first count; this also removes the taobao first-sample alert gap, so B1-08zz (FU-SERVICE-FEE-ALERT-FIRST-SAMPLE) is withdrawn. Host round 4: api unit 33/33, rule + frozen specs 82/82 (incl. [AC-B1-25b#8], [AC-B1-01zzh#5], [AC-B1-01zzo#10], [AC-B1-08zy#1]), int 4 / 15 / 9, eslint / prettier / tsc clean.

reviews.note: Codex hit its usage limit (until 11-15); fresh independent Claude via claude-run.sh (approvals #36 / D10-775), money r1 pass; one S2: first sample of a lazily created taobao series is not seen by increase()[1h] (consequence of D10-1003 ①).
Second fresh independent Claude per D10-775 ② (first attempt gave no output, exit 10, not counted; retried), pass; same S2 independently.

Codex via codex-run.sh (D10-1055: the independent-Claude per-task call breaker of 10 was reached, remaining reviews go to Codex, restored D10-1025); full static money review of the round-4 implementation, pass, no findings. A general review was asked for by D10-1055 but codex-run refuses general on RV2, so the money type was used.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by fresh independent Claude contexts in test/spec/orders/service-fee-missing-metric/** (+ NotImplemented skeletons). r1 pass with two S2 (a re-inlined condition counting jd / fee 0n would pass the pipeline tests; an info-level log with order number and amount would not be caught) — the implementation keeps the condition in serviceFeeMissingCounts and adds no log line. The first implementation hit two frozen tests; per D10-1003 test round 2 changed this task's own [AC-B1-08zy#1] to 'series only after counting' and appended CouliServiceFeeMissing to frozen [AC-B1-01zzo#10] (append only, reviewed read-only in spec-test r2). red/2 PASS (13 red in 5 files, 1 unchanged exempt); spec-test r2 pass. Round 3 (CI verify-static on #2813 after the rebase): main had widened UnionOrder['platform'], so the test's Partial<UnionOrder> patch no longer fit the fixture's taobao / jd / pdd parameter (TS2322 at pipeline.int.test.ts:36); a fresh independent Claude made only the mechanical type fix (Patch = Partial<Omit<UnionOrder, 'platform'>>), no assertion changed; red/4 PASS; spec-test r3 (incremental) pass, the two r1 S2 carried. The implementation commit is unchanged from the one both money reviewers passed. Round 4 (D10-1051, approvals 55): a fresh independent Claude changed only [AC-B1-08zy#1] to 'taobao at 0 from startup, pdd only after counting'; red/6 PASS (13 red, 1 unchanged exempt). The spec-test review of round 4 was a full review by Codex (D10-1055, engine switch after the claude-independent breaker), pass with no S0 / S1; it confirmed the frozen alert-list diff only appends one entry and a comment.
